divisions.name: Ocho Rios
divisions.note: The candidates' votes add up to 1,247; with the 19 rejected ballots that makes 1,266, against the 1,206 total votes the report prints. The figures are stored as printed. The printed shares of 49.0 and 49.5 per cent and the turnout of 38.6 per cent fit a total of 1,266.

divisions.name: Four Paths
divisions.note: The candidates' votes add up to 655; with the 8 rejected ballots that makes 663, against the 753 total votes the report prints. The figures are stored as printed. The printed share of 39.0 per cent for A. T. D. Kelly fits 294 votes, which would balance.
